banners.readOnlyUnconfirmed: Configuration is read-only until Quit status is confirmed.
banners.quitStatusUnknown: Could not read Quit status. Cleanup completion is unknown.
banners.stale: The configuration changed outside this window. Your draft and its original revision are preserved. A stale save will be refused. Copy your changes from Authoritative configuration in Settings before reloading.

draft.loginRetryWithError: {error} Save again to retry the requested login setting.

sidebarUpdates.readyAria: Updates: Update ready, Restart to install
updates.status.checking: Checking the fixed GitHub stable feed…
updates.status.downloading: Downloading and verifying the selected update…
updates.status.readyVersion: Version {version} is verified and ready to install.
updates.status.ready: The update is verified and ready to install.
updates.status.restarting: Restarting to apply the verified update.
updates.status.neverChecked: No update check has run yet.
updates.intro: Signed macOS arm64 builds only, from the fixed GitHub release feed
updates.unsupported: This build does not support updates and never contacts the update feed.
updates.automaticDescription: After launch, then daily. A newer stable version downloads on its own; installing waits for your confirmation.
updates.closeDialogFirst: Close the open server dialog before restarting.
updates.restartNote: A download installs only when the app restarts. Restarting interrupts active MCP connections and does not carry logs or unsaved drafts over.
confirm.quitBody: Your unsaved changes will be discarded. Quit stops the gateway and its backends.
confirm.updateBody: Restart MCP Gateway to install version {version}? Active MCP connections will be interrupted while the gateway and backends stop before the installer is armed.
confirm.updateDiscards: Your unsaved configuration changes will be discarded.
confirm.deleteBody: Remove {name} from the configuration? Its endpoint will stop when you save. This does not delete backend data.
whatsNew.title: What's new in {version}
overview.serversIntro: A separate endpoint for each configured MCP server
overview.clientConfigCopied: Client configuration copied. It contains your bearer token; keep it private.
overview.emptyLine1: Add a local command or an existing HTTP server.
overview.emptyLine2: Each gets its own shareable MCP endpoint.
overview.bearNote: Optional, macOS only. Bear can expose all accessible notes and tools.
overview.repairBody: No defaults have been substituted. Open Authoritative configuration in Settings to repair your original configuration.
overview.mountedNote: Mounted means the endpoint is served, not that the backend handshake succeeded. Start and Stop save the server's enabled state; the gateway starts separately.
overview.httpBody: The gateway sends the bearer token and tool data in plain HTTP. On a LAN, use only a network you trust. On a Tailscale or WireGuard address, the tunnel carries the traffic, and every device in the allowed client ranges can reach these endpoints.
overview.awakeBody: Keep this computer awake for access: sleep takes the endpoints offline, and DHCP can change a LAN address. Reachability from other devices is not verified here.
settings.preferencesIntro: Changes take effect after saving the full {filename}
settings.addressHelp: A LAN, Tailscale or WireGuard address on this Mac. Loopback is local only.
settings.peersHelp: IPv4 ranges, comma separated, such as 100.64.0.0/10. Required for a 100.64.0.0/10 address. When set, only these clients are accepted.
settings.tokenHelp: Used by servers without their own key. 32 to 512 printable ASCII characters without spaces. Client configurations include this secret.
settings.launchAtLoginDescription: Opens in the background at launch. Open the window from the menu bar.
settings.loginItemNote: The setting above is a request; this is the registration macOS has in effect.
settings.autoStart: Start gateway when the app opens
settings.autoStartDescription: Begin listening automatically, independently of login startup.
settings.paused: Structured preferences are paused until the configuration is repaired.
editor.lockedIntro: Quit cleanup has started. This draft is read-only; select and copy fields before closing.
editor.intro: Connect a local tool or an existing MCP endpoint
editor.name: Server name
editor.nameHelp: Used in {path}. Letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores.
editor.commandHelp: Executable path only. Arguments are passed separately, never through a shell.
editor.bearNote: Optional, macOS only. Bear exposes all accessible notes and tools.
editor.headersHelp: String values only. Prefer environment references such as {example}.
editor.authHelp: Servers without their own key use the global key from Settings.
editor.keyHelp: Only this key can access this server. The global key will not work.
editor.footnote: Review and save changes to update the running gateway.
logs.readFailed: Could not read local logs. Reopen Logs to retry.
logs.clearFailed: Could not clear local logs. Reopen Logs to retry.
logs.title: Backend logs
logs.intro: Full local diagnostics, kept only while the app runs
logs.sensitiveBody: Logs can contain credentials, note content and other private values. They stay in memory and are never written to disk, mirrored to the console or served over the LAN.
logs.limits: Keeps the newest {entries} entries, {megabytes} MiB in total, {kilobytes} KiB per entry. Oversized entries are marked truncated. Clearing the log does not clear the failure behind it.
logs.gap: Some earlier entries were cleared or removed by retention limits.
logs.empty: No log entries yet. Backend activity appears here after client requests.
raw.checkUnavailable: Configuration check unavailable; Save still validates.
raw.formatFailed: The configuration could not be formatted.
raw.title: Authoritative configuration
raw.subtitle: {filename} · advanced editing
raw.intro: Full file contents, including credentials. Invalid saves are rejected without discarding your draft. Preserve a copy of your edits before reloading external changes.
raw.jsonc: JSONC accepts // and /* */ comments and trailing commas.
raw.json: Strict JSON: comments and trailing commas are not allowed.
raw.rename: Changing the filename requires reopening the app.
native.discard.title: Discard unsaved changes?
native.discard.message: Discard all unsaved changes and load the latest configuration?
native.discard.detail: The saved configuration is not changed.
native.quitAck.title: Quit acknowledgement unavailable
native.quitAck.message: The application could not confirm whether the window received Quit.
native.quitAck.detail: Check the window's status before retrying. A missing acknowledgement does not authorize discarding drafts.
